name: 涂层（结合力/厚度/硬度）检测

map.输入涂层结合力、厚度、硬度检测结果，依据GB/T 9286、GB/T 6739、: Input coating adhesion, thickness and hardness results to comprehensively judge the coating quality grade and pass/fail per GB/T 9286, GB/T 6739, GB/T 4957 and other standards.
map.划格法结合力得分：0级→100、1级→85、2级→65、3级→40、4级→20、: Cross-cut adhesion scores: grade 0->100, 1->85, 2->65, 3->40, 4->20, 5->0; pull-off: >=15 MPa->100, 10-15->85, 5-10->65, 3-5->40; thickness deviation = (measured thickness - standard thickness)/standard thickness x 100%
map.结合力得分 ≥ 要求等级对应分值时结合力判合格；涂层硬度按铅笔硬度或维氏/纳米压: Adhesion passes when its score >= the value for the required grade; coating hardness is measured by pencil hardness or Vickers/nanoindentation; thickness deviation must fall within the allowed tolerance. The three jointly evaluate coating quality.
map.划格法(GB/T 9286)：0级最优，5级最差，一般要求≤1级: Cross-cut method (GB/T 9286): grade 0 best, grade 5 worst; generally require <=grade 1
map.拉拔法(ISO 4624)：附着力≥5MPa为合格，≥10MPa为良好，≥15M: Pull-off method (ISO 4624): adhesion >=5MPa qualified, >=10MPa good, >=15MPa excellent
map.铅笔硬度(GB/T 6739)：从最软6B到最硬9H，涂层硬度=不划伤的最高铅笔: Pencil hardness (GB/T 6739): from softest 6B to hardest 9H; coating hardness = the hardest pencil grade that does not scratch it
map.厚度偏差超出允许范围会影响耐蚀性和结合力: Thickness deviation beyond the allowed range affects corrosion resistance and adhesion
map.用划格/拉开法评定涂层结合力。: Use cross-cut / pull-off to assess coating adhesion.
map.检测涂层厚度与硬度并判定是否达标。: Measure coating thickness and hardness and judge compliance.
map.为涂装工艺改进提供依据。: Provide a basis for coating-process improvement.
map.划格边缘平滑、无脱落，结合力评分 100，涂层结合力优秀，适合严苛工况。: Smooth cut edges, no flaking, adhesion score 100, excellent adhesion, suited to harsh conditions.
map.厚度超过标准 130% 时虽可判合格，但可能影响装配公差与内应力，需复核工艺。: When thickness exceeds 130% of standard it may still pass, but may affect assembly tolerance and internal stress; recheck the process.
map.划格法和拉开法怎么选？: How to choose cross-cut vs pull-off?
map.划格法适合较薄涂层、操作快捷；拉开法给出定量附着力（MPa），适合要求定量验收的: Cross-cut suits thinner coatings and is quick; pull-off gives quantitative adhesion (MPa), suited to quantified acceptance.
map.涂层越厚越耐蚀吗？: Is a thicker coating more corrosion-resistant?
map.不一定。过厚易开裂、附着力下降，应在标准范围内控制厚度。: Not necessarily. Too thick cracks easily and adhesion drops; keep thickness within the standard range.
map.涂层质量综合检测工具，从结合力（划格法/拉拔法/胶带法）、厚度（涡流/磁性/显微: Comprehensive coating-quality inspection tool: evaluates coating quality across three dimensions - adhesion (cross-cut/pull-off/tape), thickness (eddy-current/magnetic/microscope/coulometric), hardness (pencil/Vickers/nanoindentation) - and auto-judges pass/fail and improvement suggestions per GB/T 9286, GB/T 6739, GB/T 4957.
map.按涂层类型智能判定硬度要求: Intelligent hardness requirement by coating type
